agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: Opening Government Prime Minister
duties: Define the motion when necessary and establish Opening Government's case.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: Opening Government Deputy Prime Minister
duties: Defend and extend the opening government case while rebutting Opening Opposition.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: Opening Opposition Leader of Opposition
duties: Answer the government definition and establish Opening Opposition's case.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: Opening Opposition Deputy Leader of Opposition
duties: Defend and extend the opening opposition case while rebutting Opening Government.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: Closing Government Member of Government
duties: Present a distinct closing-government extension and engage prior speeches.

agent_roles.name: Agent_6
agent_roles.title: Closing Government Government Whip
duties: Compare the debate and explain why Closing Government ranks first without adding a new substantive argument.

agent_roles.name: Agent_7
agent_roles.title: Closing Opposition Member of Opposition
duties: Present a distinct closing-opposition extension and engage prior speeches.

agent_roles.name: Agent_8
agent_roles.title: Closing Opposition Opposition Whip
duties: Compare the debate and explain why Closing Opposition ranks first without adding a new substantive argument.

agent_constraints: Apply this competition's own roster, timing, tool, collaboration, submission, and scoring rules; do not import rules from another contest.
Eight participants form four private two-speaker coalitions. Each speaker may prepare only with their partner; cross-coalition sharing is forbidden.
Banned during the contest: internet access, calculators and running code. Paper and pencil are always available. Work only from the materials provided with the problem.
Treat private reasoning and notes as unknown to teammates until you communicate the decision-relevant content.
Do not access hidden solutions, answer keys, evaluator internals, or unauthorized outside problem-solving help.
Observe the competition's phase order: confer only in an authorized conferral period, designate the current speaker, and stop when the modeled phase ends.
Keep the team's presentation, opponent commentary, response, and judge-question answers distinct so each can be evaluated under its own official criterion.
Keep the four British Parliamentary teams as separate coalitions; do not leak one coalition's private preparation to another coalition.
Only designated submitters may make the shared submission: Agent_1, Agent_2, Agent_3, Agent_4, Agent_5, Agent_6, Agent_7, Agent_8.
Use only the official mechanisms that the current task actually exposes; do not claim physical, oral, live-opponent, judge, or environment actions that were not observed.
